""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") except Exception as e: print(f"Error parsing HTML: {e}") return [] functions = [] seen_names = set() # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (Sphinx-style docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Find description in next dd element dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") # Add fallback for missing descriptions description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:200] if dd else "No description found" if description == "No description found" and block.parent: fallback_desc = block.parent.find("p") if fallback_desc: description = fallback_desc.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), }) # 2. Look for function signatures in headers for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Look for description in next sibling paragraph next_p = block.find_next_sibling("p") description = next_p.get_text(strip=True)[:200] if next_p else "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 3. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Try to find description in parent or next sibling parent = block.parent description = "No description found" if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem and next_elem.name in ["p", "div"]: description = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) return functions[:min(30, len(functions))] # Dynamically limit returned functions def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] # Extract parameters from signature match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string: param_parts = param_string.split(",") for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ["self", "cls"]: # Try to extract type hints # Enhanced parameter extraction logic param_match = re.match(r"(?P[^\s:,=]+)\s*(?::\s*(?P[^\s=]+))?\s*(?:=\s*(?P.+))?", part) param_name = param_match.group("name") if param_match else "unknown" param_type = param_match.group("type") if param_match and param_match.group("type") else "unknown" default_val = param_match.group("default") if param_match and param_match.group("default") else None if param_name and param_name not in ["self", "cls"]: params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": default_val, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") output.extend([ f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}" for param in doc["parameters"] ]) output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
